chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a shy king who ruled over a kingdom. In his kingdom he had recorders who wrote down everything the king said and did. One day the king was feeling very shy and he decided to hide. He tried to make sure no one could find him. Suddenly one of the recorders noticed the king had gone missing and he declared an alert. The entire kingdom searched everywhere but they could not find the king. Everyone was getting worried. After days of searching the kingdom finally found the king! He had been hiding in the nearby forest. The recorders were overjoyed and they quickly got to work and recorded all the events of the king's disappearance. The kingdom was relieved and the shy king vowed to never hide again.

chapters.title: Mama bear was getting ready for…
p: Mama bear was getting ready for the big race. She put on her helmet which was very expensive. She said goodbye to her little bear cub and told him to cheer for her.
The race started and Mama bear was going very fast. At the same time, her cub started looking around the room. He found an expensive chocolate bar.
He was so excited he started to chew it up!
Mama Bear had finished the race and was very happy. But when she got home, she saw what the cub had done. He had chewed the chocolate bar and it was all gone!
Mama bear looked at the cub sadly and said, “You should never chew anything without asking first! We have to respect things, even if they are expensive.”
The cub nodded and promised to remember the lesson. He learned he should always think before he chews!

chapters.title: Once there was a little fox…
p: Once there was a little fox named Sam who was very curious. Every day he would explore the forest, looking for new and exciting places to play. One day, he came across a strange tree. It was so strange that he climbed up it without even thinking twice about it.

When Sam got to the top of the tree, he was amazed. There was a big surprise inside the tree waiting for him - a big bowl full of treats! Sam was so excited that he quickly grabbed a few of the treats and started to eat them.

Suddenly, he heard a voice. It was the tree! It said "Welcome, little fox. I am the guardian of this tree, and I want to reward you for being brave enough to explore new places. Please, take a few more treats - they are my special reward for being curious." Sam was so happy that he thanked the tree and continued to munch on his treats.
The moral of this story is that if we stay curious and explore new things, we can sometimes be rewarded!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time, there were two friends, Jane and Sarah. They were very good friends and always did fun things together.
One day, Jane and Sarah decided to plan a special trip. They wanted to go to a temple that was very modern.
So, Jane and Sarah made plans and got ready for their adventure. The night before they left, they packed their bags and went to bed early.
The next day, Jane and Sarah drove nearly all day. When they arrived at the temple, they were excited. It was beautiful and modern, just like they expected.
They spent the day exploring and learning about the temple. Jane and Sarah had a wonderful time. They were happy they had planned such a fun trip.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an old man. He used to be strong and full of energy, but now he was very weak. He used to love to play in the garden, but now it was too hard for him to move.
The old man was very sad. He not only felt tired and lonely, but he suffered greatly. Every day he looked around and saw other people playing and having fun, but he couldn't do the same.
One day, the old man found a disgusting old bug. He was so surprised and scared by it, he said "Hello old creepy bug - why you here?"
The old bug said, "I suffer too, just like you. Look around, there is suffering everywhere. We must try to be kind to each other, even when it is hard."
The old man was very thankful for the old bug's wise words. They said goodbye and the old man went away feeling much happier than before.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there were…
p: Once upon a time, there were two best friends. They were called Lulu and Jack.
One day, Lulu and Jack were playing in the garden when it suddenly got dark. It was time to go inside but Lulu was scared of the dark.
"Jack," said Lulu, "Please get the lamp!"
So Jack went inside and he found a pale lamp. He carried it outside and put it on the grass. It lit up the garden with a calming, warm light.
Lulu was very happy. She gave Jack a big hug and said, "Thank you for bringing the lamp!"
The two friends played until it was time for them to go to bed. Then they said goodnight and went inside.
The End.

chapters.title: Once there was a popular boy…
p: Once there was a popular boy who everyone loved. He had a special talent for measuring things. One day he decided to use his measuring skills to find out how high the fire was. He wanted to see how far away from the fire he could get.

He started to measure it very carefully. Every time he took a step back the fire seemed to get bigger and bigger. It was almost like it was calling out to him. He felt like he had to get closer and closer. But he just kept measuring the fire.
The fire had grown bigger and bigger, until the popular boy was right in the middle of it! He screamed and cried. But it was too late. The fire had grown too large and he couldn't escape it.

The poor boy was never seen again. Everyone was so sad because of what happened to the popular boy. The only thing they could do was remember his brave spirit and his special talents. They will never forget him.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny. She was very creative and she loved to use her imagination in everything she did. She was in her bedroom one day and she noticed something strange.
Jenny: "Mommy, what is that?"
Mom: "That, Jenny, is a bed."
Jenny: "A bed? What's a bed?"
Mom: "Well, a bed is a place to sleep and rest. Now, why don't you climb into it and see what it feels like?"
So Jenny climbed into the bed and she recognized that it was very comfy. She snuggled in and it felt warm and cozy.
Jenny: "Mommy, I like this bed!"
Mom: "That's good, Jenny. You are so creative!"
Jenny smiled and snuggled into the bed even more. From then on, she always remembered the feeling of a bed, and it made her feel safe and secure.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a princess who was feeling very gloomy. She had a big challenge to succeed, but she wasn't sure if she could do it. She was scared it was too hard for her.
But her friends came to help her. They gave her kind words and said, “We believe in you, Princess!”
The Princess smiled and was feeling brave again. She was determined to succeed and she set out on her mission.
With the help and courage of her friends, she was able to do it. She had succeeded!
Everyone was so proud and they all cheered. The Princess was very happy, and her gloominess was gone.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a young girl. She loved to play and explore. One day she wanted to try something new. She asked her mother if she could have a special dish. Her mother said yes and gave the girl a dish.

The young girl was excited! She took the dish outside and looked closely at it. The dish was full of all sorts of goodies. She couldn't believe her eyes. She took a bit of each thing, and was so happy with what she received.

The young girl had so much fun tasting all the different things in the dish. She thought it was the best thank she had ever gotten! She ate until she was full and thanked her mother for the dish. The young girl smiled and played the rest of the day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a wise old man. Every day, he would stretch his legs in the morning and always have lots of energy to do his chores. He had an old mop that he used to clean up, but he was getting tired of it.
One day, the old man was so fed up that he went out and bought a new mop. The mop was bigger, better, and more efficient than his old one. So he decided to throw away his old one.

That night, a little boy knocked on his door. He said he had been looking for his old mop, but he couldn't find it anywhere. When the old man told him he had thrown it out, the little boy started to cry.

The old man could feel guilty so he asked the little boy why the mop was important to him. The little boy explained to him that it belonged to his grandmother and that it was very special to him. The old man suddenly felt regret for his actions.
But it was too late and the bad deed was already done. The old man was not so wise after all.

chapters.title: Once there was a strong igloo…
p: Once there was a strong igloo. It was built by some polar bears and they were very proud of it.
One day a fox was walking around and he saw the igloo. He wanted to see how strong it was, so he decided to cut it with a sharp knife.
He started cutting the igloo but it was too strong for him. A polar bear who had seen the fox cutting came over to him and said:
"Why are you cutting my igloo?"
The fox said he wanted to see how strong it was.
The bear then said,"No cutting! This igloo is a very good home for me and my friends. Leave it alone!"
The fox agreed and he ran away.
The polar bears were very happy because the igloo was still strong. They thanked the bear who had saved their igloo. From then on they kept it even stronger.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a kind and patient village. In this village lived a girl named Eva.
One day, Eva went to the village store. She asked the shopkeeper for a new toy. He said no. Eva waved her fist and refused, but the shopkeeper was not angry. He was patient.

Next, Eva took a walk around the village. She passed the village pond, the village field and finally the village church. She asked the church Doorkeeper if she could go inside. He said no. Eva crossed her arms and refused, but the Doorkeeper was not angry. He was patient.
Finally, Eva went home. She asked her mum if she could stay up past bedtime. Her mum said no. Eva stamped her foot and refused, but her mum was still kind and patient.
In the end, the village was proud of Eva. They were happy she was so brave, but they were also proud of her for being so patient.

chapters.title: Mama and Papa took Sarah to…
p: Mama and Papa took Sarah to the fireplace, and Sarah was excited. She had never been to the fireplace before. Mama and Papa picked up some wood and put it in the fireplace. Sarah said, "Wow!"
Then Mama lit a match and she lit the wood in the fireplace, and a fire began to burn. Sarah was so amazed! She said, "Look! Fire!" Papa said, "Remember, Sarah, to never touch the fire."

Next, Sarah and Mama and Papa sat together in front of the fireplace, and they toasted marshmallows. They put them on a stick and held them near the fire, and when they were golden brown, Mama and Papa put the marshmallows in a bowl with some spicy sauce. Sarah smiled, and it made Mama and Papa laugh.
Suddenly, Mama reached for Sarah's hand and gave it a squeeze to remind her of how hot the fire was. Sarah smiled and said, "I remember!"

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a brave explorer who had an eager heart to rescue the world. She packed her bag full of supplies and went to explore. She went on an adventure, taking big steps and smiling the whole way.
Suddenly, the brave explorer came to a big hill. From the top of the hill, she could see a wide world. It was so big that she couldn't believe her eyes!
She noticed something strange. In the middle of the world was a huge lake with a boat stuck inside. She saw somebody waving and shouting, "Help me! Please rescue me!"

The brave explorer was eager to help. She tied her bag to her back and slowly made her way down the hill. When she got to the lake, she jumped in and started to paddle the boat. Within minutes, the person inside was free!
The explorer was so happy she had been able to rescue the world. She waved goodbye to the person in the boat, smiled and took off to explore more!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little boy named Dave. He liked to dig in the garden with his spade. One day, he was poking the ground with his spade, looking for worms.
Suddenly, Dave felt something soft and squishy. He poked harder and out of the soil came a big juicy strawberry! "Wow!" he said. "It looks very tasty!"
Dave picked the strawberry up and took a bite. He chewed it slowly and smiled. It was so yummy!
Just then, he heard his mom calling him.
"Dave, come here," said Mom. "I need some help picking some tomatoes."
Dave nodded and put down his spade. He grabbed the strawberry and took one last bite before running back to his mom.
It had been a great day in the garden!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a clumsy little bear who liked to explore the world. One day, she was walking through a dark and gloomy forest when suddenly she saw a special light. As she got closer, she could see that power was making the light glow. The power was so strong that it was like a magical surprise!

The little bear was so excited that she jumped up to try to catch the power. But it was too slippery for her little paws and the power just kept on glowing. She tried with all her might to get hold of this special power, but nothing worked.

Finally, the bear had an idea - she stood still and wished as hard as she could that the power would stay with her. Miraculously, the power understood and it stayed with her like a faithful friend. The bear was so happy that the power was always with her - she felt invincible!
The little bear explored the forest with the glowing power, never having to worry about darkness or loneliness again. From then on, the clumsy little bear was never afraid!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a man called Mark. Mark liked to speed. He loved it! He would speed everywhere.
One day, Mark decided to try and speed around the earth! He was so excited. He worked hard and he was patient. He asked a lot of questions and learned lots.
When he was ready, Mark began his mission to speed around the world. It was an amazing sight! He sped and sped and sped. Soon enough, the whole earth had been sped around!
Mark was so pleased with his work. He had done it! He had speeded around the earth. Everyone was cheering and cheering.
They all thanked him for being so patient and determined. He had been so brave and never gave up.
Mark had done it! He had sped around the earth.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a rabbit named Ralph. Ralph was very popular with all his friends, but he was very shy. Ralph liked to keep a diary. Every day he wrote down all the things that happened with his friends in his diary.

One day, Ralph and his friends caught a group of birds playing in the garden. They decided to shoot the birds with their toy guns. Poor Ralph didn't want to shoot the birds, but his friends kept encouraging him to join in the fun.
Ralph felt really sad so he ran away. Later that night he wrote in his diary about how bad it felt to shoot the birds. He wrote:" It is never fun to hurt an animal, no matter how popular you are."
Moral of the story: It is okay to be popular, but it is never okay to hurt animals.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was an alarm. Every morning it was very bright and loud. Every morning it said “come!”. So everyone came to wake up. Everyone got up and listened to the bright alarm. It said “come, come, come!”. So everyone came to get dressed and eat breakfast. Then it was time to go to school and play. After school everyone came back home to eat dinner. Then it was time for bed and the alarm said “come!” again. So everyone came to brush their teeth and take a bath. Then the alarm said “come to bed”, so everyone came to bed and fell asleep. The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful doll. Her name was Matilda, and she lived in a big white house.

One day, Matilda heard a ring. It was a special ring that meant she had to go to the hospital. Matilda was scared, but the people at the hospital were very kind. They said that Matilda needed an operation.

Matilda did not understand, so the people at the hospital explained. They said that the operation would help Matilda be healthy. All Matilda had to do was take deep breaths while they were doing the operation.

Matilda was still a bit scared, but she took a deep breath and looked around. Everything was very soft and gentle. Matilda felt safe and relaxed. Then, before she knew it, the operation was over. Matilda sighed in relief and smiled.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there lived…
p: Once upon a time, there lived a small mouse. The mouse was very happy in her home, until one day a wizard decided to cast a spell. The spell made the mouse very mad, so she decided to strike back. She ran around the wizard’s house, trying to find a way to stop the spell.

After a lot of looking, the mouse finally found a small book in the wizard's kitchen. It was a special book that could break any spell. She ran back out of the house, grabbed the book, and hurried to the wizard. The mouse bravely offered the book to the wizard and asked him to break the spell.

The wizard was pleased with the mouse’s bravery, and used the book to break the spell. The mouse was so happy that she hugged the wizard, thanked him for breaking the spell, and ran back to her home. The mouse was relieved that her home was safe and sound again, and that no spells would strike her!

chapters.title: Molly was walking in the park…
p: Molly was walking in the park. She saw a squirrel, who was looking very bossy perched up on a tree. Molly felt a little scared and shivered. She wanted to get closer and take a better look, but the squirrel was too bossy.
Suddenly, Molly heard someone call from behind. It was Mary who was also in the park.
"Hi Molly!" Mary said. "I have some food for the squirrel. Would you like to come and feed it with me?"

Molly smiled and started to walk over to Mary. When the squirrel saw the food, it hopped down from the tree and started eating. Molly and Mary both laughed. Molly was no longer scared, she was so excited to see the squirrel getting all the food.
At the end of the day, Mary and Molly said goodbye to the squirrel and walked back home. Molly was filled with happiness as she walked away.

chapters.title: One day there was a famous…
p: One day, there was a famous man named Jack. He liked to jog every morning. He went outside and put on his special socks. The socks were made especially for running. They were very soft, and he felt comfy in them.
Jack started to jog around the park. He ran past a lake, a tree and a big, green hill. He jogged around and around for a long time. He felt happy and truly enjoyed his morning jog.
When he was finished jogging, Jack started to wave to the people around him. Some clapped and cheered, because he was famous! Jack smiled and felt very proud.

The next morning, Jack put on his special jogging socks and started to jog around the park again. He didn't feel tired at all and it felt really good to stretch his legs. He jogged around and around, smiling with joy as he waved to the people around him.

chapters.title: Once there was a little boy…
p: Once there was a little boy who loved to touch things. He touched everything he saw. One day, he saw a secret box that was tucked away in a corner of the room. It was a very special box and he knew it had something special inside. He touched the box and he liked the way it felt. His friend saw him touching it and she got very nosy. She asked what was inside the box and the little boy said it was a secret. No matter how much she asked, he wouldn't tell and kept the secret safe. The nosy friend argued and begged, but the little boy didn't change his mind. He kept the special secret inside the box.
